result.summary: The page layout is mostly clean, with one minor visual inconsistency found in the second promotional card's favorite icon styling.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen' card has a white background circle while the same icon on the pizza card below has a dark/black background circle, creating inconsistent styling between similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background color across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
